mapper.select: SELECT id AS patientCardId, name, sex, pid, tel, birthday, medical_history AS medicalHistory FROM patient_user_info WHERE id = #{patientCardId}

SELECT mr.id AS registrationId, mr.date AS date, mr.slot AS slot, mr.status AS status, mr.payment_status AS paymentStatus, md.name AS deptName, mds.name AS deptSubName, d.name AS doctorName, dcr.diagnosis AS diagnosis, dcr.rp AS prescription FROM medical_registration mr LEFT JOIN doctor d ON mr.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN medical_dept_sub mds ON mr.dept_sub_id = mds.id LEFT JOIN medical_dept md ON mds.dept_id = md.id LEFT JOIN doctor_consultation_report dcr ON dcr.registration_id = mr.id WHERE mr.patient_card_id = #{patientCardId} ORDER BY mr.create_time DESC
